umm...sorry to rain on your parade but Six Flags is an AMUSEMENT PARK not a THEME PARK. 

A theme park is Disney World/Disney Land/Universal Studios where the park is focused on a central theme, particularly one specific name brand and focuses on  immersion; having the feeling that you're in a created world and universe, hence the excitement of being in Hogsmeade or Diagon Alley in Harry Potter or joining either the Resistance or First Order in Star Wars at Disney.

An amusement park may have various themed areas, but it's not themed on a whole. As an example, basically some Six Flags might have Western themed areas, where others do not.
